ownership.fallback: consumer-supplied command-substring predicate; migrated entries must keep their legacy substring so not-yet-migrated tools still recognize their own entries

conventions.mergePolicy: owner-scoped strip-then-append: remove only entries owned by the caller, append fresh ones, preserve every foreign byte; whole-file overwrite is allowed only for tool-owned files

pathPlaceholders.{id}: rule or file id chosen by the consumer

conventions.scopeResolution: project paths resolve against the repository root; user paths against the home directory unless an envOverrides key is set
conventions.mcpPolicy: MCP configs are keyed maps (server name -> server object). Container key, url field name and token-env syntax differ per client; the map is a shared file so writes must be owner-scoped by server name. Non-JSON formats (jsonc/toml) are print-only.

mcp.note: env var name must not look like a credential (ANTHROPIC_*/AWS_* are substituted empty); verify against /mcp

codex.name: Codex CLI

copilot.name: VS Code Copilot (local hooks)
copilot.notes: Preview feature: tool names are not a stable API - gate payloads by shape (file_path+content / old+new_string / edits[] / V4A patch text), never by name. Per-tool file ownership makes overwrite safe here.

crush.name: Crush
crush.notes: No AfterTool hook exists - failure observation is degraded (pre-tool only). Entries are flat {matcher, command}.

type value is `streamable-http` (hyphen); literal token in header; server object carries disabled:false

goose.name: goose
goose.notes: Hooks are a plugin-scoped JSON file (regex matcher, seconds). MCP lives in config.yaml (container `extensions`, url `uri`) - not representable here, verify before wiring. Backward-compat read paths .goose/skills and .claude/skills.

hermes.name: Hermes Agent
hermes.notes: Shell hooks live in config.yaml (YAML, not JSON): {matcher, command, timeout seconds, fail_closed}; project scope `.hermes/` is trust-gated (verify). MCP container `mcp_servers` (YAML).

openhands.name: OpenHands
openhands.notes: Claude-Code-compatible hook entries {matcher, hooks:[{command,timeout,async,type}]}; also .openhands/setup.sh and AGENTS.md. MCP is user-scope only (no per-project file).

continue.name: Continue
continue.notes: CLI only (IDE extension has no hooks); hook config precedence .claude/ < .continue/ < *.local.json. MCP in config.yaml (YAML) or .continue/mcpServers/*.json.

junie.name: Junie

mcp.note: type/transport inferred from command vs url; interpolation unknown

junie.notes: CLI. Project-local hooks are ignored for safety - load explicitly. MCP file .junie/mcp/mcp.json (print-only: interpolation unverified).

oh-my-pi.name: Oh My Pi
oh-my-pi.notes: Pi fork. Hooks are TS/JS modules (.omp/hooks/pre|post), no JSON hook surface. MCP supports `${VAR}` and `${VAR:-default}`.

pi.name: Pi
pi.notes: Hooks only via TS extensions (pi.on), no JSON hook surface. MCP type is stdio|http|streamable-http (inferred from command/url).

kimi-code.name: Kimi Code

mcp.note: bearerTokenEnvVar holds the env-var NAME (no literal secret); no `${VAR}` interpolation

kimi-code.notes: Hooks are user-scope only in config.toml (TOML): {event, matcher, command, timeout seconds} - no project hook file. MCP also .kimi-code/mcp.json; transport `sse` explicit, stdio/http inferred.

amp.name: Amp
amp.notes: Closed-source (sourcegraph/amp repo is 404; docs at ampcode.com). No hook config - event-driven TS plugins. MCP lives under the literal top-level key `amp.mcpServers`; file may be .jsonc (kept print-only).

zcode.name: ZCode

mcp.note: JSON only (JSONC unsupported); container is the nested path `mcp.servers`; no env interpolation - remote tokens go in `headers` or via `oauth`; `.agents/mcp.json` key `mcpServers` is a fallback only (no merge)

zcode.notes: Z.ai's GLM-5.3 harness (`zcode`). Hook events sit under `hooks.events.<Event>` matcher groups (extra `hooks.enabled`/`timeoutMs` envelope); `timeoutMs` is milliseconds, legacy `timeout` is seconds and loses to `timeoutMs`. Project hooks are ignored in current builds (repo contract says conditionally executed behind trust - verify). Instructions via AGENTS.md. Config is JSON only.

deepseek.name: DeepSeek Harness
deepseek.notes: Config is a Cordis plugin composition: ordered YAML patch layers (`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`, profile `cordis.patch.yml`) over a JSON profile manifest - no hook/MCP JSON file surface. Hooks exist only as opt-in bridges that read Claude Code / Codex `hooks.json`. MCP servers are per-server `dsh-mcp-client` plugin rows in YAML. Skills: `<name>/SKILL.md` or flat `<name>.md`, nested `**/SKILL.md` unsupported. Instructions via AGENTS.md (+ CLAUDE.md).
